_about: Default rules for automatic GPS outlier detection. Edit to change them for every visitor; each visitor can still tweak them in «Диагностика → Настроить» (kept in their browser). Unknown keys are ignored.
_speed: A segment between two points faster than maxKmh is a glitch (teleport or signal loss).
_jump: A single step longer than maxM, or longer than vsMedian × the track's typical step, is a signal-loss jump.
_spike: A point that flies off and comes back: both legs to its neighbours are longer than minM and the angle at the point is below maxAngleDeg (a sharp V; ordinary corners are ~90°).
_mergeGapPoints: Outliers separated by at most this many clean points are merged into one stretch.
_pause: Standing still: slower than maxKmh for at least minSec. Affects moving time, pause bands and «Удалить паузы».
